benchmark: Vikunja v2.4.0 professional API benchmark (/api/v1, bounded scope)
sourceArtifacts: GitHub issue #25 comment 6594929761 (reported Gemma result, receipts not independently attested in this checkout)
interpreterSupplies: state machine, storage, auth plumbing, permission enforcement, HTTP serving

arms.label: GEMMA_TEST
arms.condition: Compiler-assisted per-route synthesis: model edits deterministic compiled facts (templates carried, contract fields model-decided)

oracle.label: NON_AI
oracle.description: Hand-written oracle spec (public observations only), executed by the generic candidate interpreter. Plumbing control, never a model result.

limitations: Gemma arms are GEMMA_TEST (gemma-4-26b-a4b-it via gemma-test provider), not Meta Muse and not REAL_MODEL.
Provider failures (B, D) are unscored; they are never reported as 0/6.
A (prior only) vs C (grounded) does not isolate the coverage-gate effect.

HYBRID (GEMMA_TEST, model-authored): per-route model edits of the compiled facts scored 3/6 held-out (spec file sha256:df2981dbda3bd11cd77c92ebf8b48f803225a4901857870d1fe04dcca0171d17) vs model-only C 2/6 and compiled NON_AI 6/6; public conformance 7/19; bounded repair call not admitted/provider-failed. The model improves unaided synthesis but its contract edits still degrade compiled facts.

EVIDENCE_COMPILED 6/6 is deterministic transcription of the 20 public observations (spec sha256:a5c9104eebe74bf1f7620a7ca67d28535dbae87728ee4bcce246afe127ad4984; evidence sha256:40f23ce95eb9199a3c9cef33b8dd440f2f9afd0f0a298a9fdfb07342a5f66777), re-verified this session with a status-mutation control scoring 2/6. It is NON_AI — not a model result. The model-authored Gemma C remains 2/6.
Scores on this benchmark are not comparable to the 14/25 ledger score: different target, suite and denominator.
Contamination caveat: Vikunja is popular open source; a good score may reflect reconstruction plus possible recall.
Reported Gemma scores come from issue #25 comment 6594929761; private receipts were not independently inspected in this review.
